TazkiraVerificationBottomMessageSubTitle:
If the employee information recorded in the payroll system matches the information retrieved from the electronic ID (e-Tazkira) system, click the "Confirm and Register Information Based on the Electronic ID System" button.

Please note that in some cases the information may not appear exactly the same due to spaces, punctuation, or minor differences in characters. If, after reviewing the information, you are confident that the data retrieved from the electronic ID system belongs to the same person, you may proceed with the confirmation.

Otherwise, obtain the correct ID number from the employee and verify the information again before confirming.

Please be aware that once the information is confirmed, the employee's data will be transferred from the electronic ID system to the payroll system and will no longer be editable in the payroll system.
